lead: Reema Lagoo was an Indian film actor, born on 21 June 1958 in Mumbai.
She died on 18 May 2017 in Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital at the age of 58.
She has 40 credited works on public record.
This profile collects the Reema facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Reema Lagoo — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Reema Lagoo was born on 21 June 1958 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality. She was given the name Nayan Bhadbhade at birth and is publicly known as Reema Lagoo.
She received her education at Huzurpaga.
She is recorded as speaking Hindi and Marathi.
